text: Final pre-commit gate on the exact working tree: scalafmtCheckAll passed and testAll passed 866 tests across core JVM/JS, laws JVM/JS, SVG JVM/JS, notebook, performance JVM/JS, Canvas JS, Java2D, PDF, and JavaFX. A meta-contract test now pins the three marker shapes, 1.5pt-to-2px stroke resolution at the canonical 96ppi target, and non-default text color/font/size/alpha requirements.
